notes: RBox revision of the topic's inverse slot: the inverse of 'succeeded' (preceded, tagged inverse:preceded in RELATIONS.md) is replaced by 'appointed'. Both instances are hereditary successions with no appointment by the predecessor (Victoria died in 1901; Louis XVI was Louis XV's grandson and heir), so the edited conclusion is false in reality and not merely unentailed; US presidents and Roman emperors are avoided because they often chose their successors.
